title: Ragi Dosa
description: Instant finger millet dosa made without fermentation, crisp, lacy and dotted with onion and curry leaves.
steps: Whisk the ragi flour and rice flour with the salt and about 400 ml of water to a thin, watery batter without lumps.
Stir in the onion, green chilli, curry leaves and cumin seeds.
Heat a cast iron or non-stick tawa until hot and grease lightly with oil.
Stir the batter well each time, then pour a ladle from a little height, starting at the outside and spiralling inward, so it forms a lacy round.
Drizzle a little oil on top and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp and the edges lift.
Fold and serve with coconut chutney or sambar; no flipping is needed.
